description: Tool to list all SearchAds360Links on a property. Use when you need to retrieve all Search Ads 360 links for a given Google Analytics property. Supports pagination for large result sets.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing SearchAds360Links for a Google Analytics property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of resources to return. Default is 50, maximum is 200. Values exceeding 200 are capped at maximum.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous list call. Use this to retrieve the next page. All other parameters must match the original request.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The property resource name. Format: properties/{propertyId} (e.g., properties/1234).
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: AnalyticsAdminPropertiesSearchAds360LinksListRequest

name: list_search_ads360_links

nextPageToken.description: A token that can be sent as pageToken to retrieve the next page. Omitted if there are no subsequent pages.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

searchAds360Links.description: Collection of SearchAds360Link objects representing connections between a Google Analytics property and Search Ads 360 entities.
searchAds360Links.title: Search Ads360 Links

SearchAds360Link.description:
Schema for a SearchAds360Link resource representing a connection between a
Google Analytics property and Search Ads 360 entity.

adsPersonalizationEnabled.description: Enables personalized advertising features. Defaults to true if unset.
adsPersonalizationEnabled.title: Ads Personalization Enabled

advertiserDisplayName.description: Output only. Display name of the Search Ads 360 Advertiser for easy identification.
advertiserDisplayName.title: Advertiser Display Name

advertiserId.description: Immutable. The Advertiser ID of the Search Ads 360 Advertiser that has been linked.
advertiserId.title: Advertiser Id

campaignDataSharingEnabled.description: Immutable. Enables import of campaign data from Search Ads 360. Defaults to true if unset.
campaignDataSharingEnabled.title: Campaign Data Sharing Enabled

costDataSharingEnabled.description: Immutable. Enables import of cost data from Search Ads 360. Requires campaignDataSharingEnabled to be true. Defaults to true if unset.
costDataSharingEnabled.title: Cost Data Sharing Enabled

siteStatsSharingEnabled.description: Enables export of site stats. Defaults to true if unset.
siteStatsSharingEnabled.title: Site Stats Sharing Enabled
